comments.author: Shynd
comments.body_html:
I don’t know where the confusion is but this mod doesn’t have any performance optimization or FPS booster methods. The performance the description mentions pertains only to this mod: it caches loot containers so that it doesn’t scan for new containers constantly.

Running this mod will not increase your FPS vs not running this mod.

Edit: 2026.01.20 – This mod now does seem to have distance-based bot culling so it will affect performance if enabled, but it does so by calling SetActive(value) on each bot outside of the configured distance which ungracefully disables the entire bot. It’s not just a render disable, the bot will be disabled, similar to an AI Limit mod. The feature description on the mod page does not accurately describe what this setting does.

I’m sure this edit is going to get my comment unpinned, but this mod appears to be entirely put together with LLM tools and there are a few hints that the mod author does not fully understand the code. I would personally be cautious about using this.

Edit: 2026.01.22 – I’m glad to see this is marked with the ‘Includes AI Generated Content’ tag now. Cheers! Edit2: 2026.03.18 – Okay now the AI Generated Content tag is gone. Shame.

comments.author: Master
comments.body_html:
There’s absolutely no way I’m going to unpin your comment, but I know exactly what my code is doing. Saying it was an LLM when I’m busting my ass to get things done is kind of messed up, but whatever…

English just isn’t my native language, and I have some difficulty finding the right words to use when describing what I’m doing or what I plan to do. About the mod, I wrote the description as “Culling provides a small performance boost by disabling meshes at distance” because explaining everything down to the smallest details is exhausting, and I’m focused on development.

So I described the part that’s visually the most obvious to everyone about what the mod does. And I tested it a lot — even with it enabled and then disabled afterward, everything worked fine. This habit you guys have of saying everything is LLM is getting annoying.

comments.author: Shynd
comments.body_html:
I have definitely made some assumptions without concrete proof, that’s for sure, but I was also careful to state that it “appears” to be LLM-assisted, which it does. If it’s not, great! That’s between you and your conscience, I don’t have a stake in whether that’s true or not. If it is, I think it should be disclosed, that’s all.

LLM assistance when programming is something I utilize quite often, I did not mean for it to sound like it’s some evil tool that should be shunned, if that’s what it sounded like.

I do believe that it is very important to describe exactly what is happening in mod descriptions as that is what users rely on to determine how their game is being modified. If you say it is just culling / not rendering meshes when you are in fact completely disabling the bot object, that can lead to confusion or mod incompatibility for users who have been misled by the mischaracterization of the feature. And I think it is important for the truth of what is being done to be available somewhere, even if in the comments.

Your description was misleading. How am I to know if that’s an intentional choice made by you or because you don’t understand what your code is doing?

Point blank: was an LLM used to assist in programming this mod?
